rows.text: Choose folds and their order to wrap a paper filling.

Today’s zongzi is a paper-space puzzle. Open the leaves and place an imaginary paper filling. A wrong fold can be unfolded. Watch how each plane covers the shape. This is a creative puzzle, not a cooking tutorial.
